This is a concrete durable owned item reconciliation boundary relevant to old-save preservation, not merely a serializer wrapper. Full graph persistence framework and native callback guarantees remain unproved. Not a new player Clone field, paid maker receipt or Dynasty runtime pass.

actual_complete_chain_and_limits.finding: Disk read clears connectedPorts, reads Address/OfflineBuffer/Primed keyed by saved Pos, resets nearestTrain weak ref. Duplicate positions overwrite; absent Ports yields empty map. Disk write retains full handler payload and primed; network write omits Ports. migration=true parent skips BE dimension/position restore but GlobalStation still reads port records; no coordinate rewrite/topology migration consumer proved.

Live port has SmartInventory18 and own saved Inventory/Target/AddressFilter/AcceptsPackages. Postbox.setChanged calls saveOfflineBuffer server-only if tracked station+same position port exists. Save assigns each stack from live into offline handler with no explicit copy, marks railway dirty, and returns immediately when restoring. Newly created attached port gets address only; no immediate snapshot in shown attach method, existing address not refreshed there.

Arrival and periodic present-station tick invoke actual mail transfer. If same-dimension level has loaded position resolving any PostboxBlockEntity, use its live inventory; otherwise use port offlineBuffer even when another loaded block type is present. Import skips packages matching station address; export selects matching. Insert destination first, clear source slot only empty returned remainder. Successful offline transfer sets primed=true and marks tracks dirty; loaded transfer uses callback/snapshot path and particles.

Attach sets tracked station before existing port restore. Primed guard avoids ordinary reapplication. Restore sets restoring=true, writes all offline slots into live inventory, then restoring=false and primed=false. Offline buffer remains shadow snapshot, not cleared. Removing port deletes map entry. No try/finally, range/cardinality validation, merge policy or compensation in restore; exception can leave restoring=true and primed uncleared, partially applied live state. No failure reproduced.

Project-side callback continuation traced: SmartInventory.setStackInSlot delegates inherited native handler; SyncedStackHandler.onContentsChanged notifies BE, notifyUpdate dispatches setChanged then sendData, Postbox.setChanged snapshots. Restoring flag blocks callback copy-back that could otherwise replace unread later offline slots with partial live contents. Actual native ItemStackHandler setStackInSlot->onContentsChanged dispatch/reference behavior was NOT read independently. No concurrency, reentrancy failure safety or detached-copy guarantee.

Built-in package registration goes through properties stacksTo(1). Ordinary valid built-in single package cannot be assumed to suffer generic multi-item partial-stack duplication merely because insert-before-clear pattern exists. Modified counts, addon PackageItem properties, capability return contracts and handler aliasing untested. Package style list is not multiple mechanisms.

Computer event preparation occurs BEFORE remainder success check, not delivery receipt. markTracksDirty only calls savedData.setDirty if nonnull; Train tick also requests dirty. No direct immediate disk commit or source/destination crash atomicity. Restore clearing primed has no explicit railway dirty call here; surrounding save lifecycle may persist it, so do not assert either guaranteed persistence or definite loss.
